carrier_policy.definition: q_perp=min{q prime: q divides k and q does not divide h}
carrier_policy.e1_boundary: The oriented ideal factor (q_perp,omega-lambda)|(a-b*omega) is algebraic evidence only. The requested envelope must additionally bind this q_perp to a specific integer raw side/node/path above current K capacity and prove one-use support charge conservation.

target_shapes.mark_behavior: preserve ordinary Sol(p); no nontrivial mark may be introduced
target_shapes.t5_ticket_type: LOCAL_DROP in the fixed T5 N7 TYPEI/CHARGED rank, or reject
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: run terminal first; on MISS the target uniquely matches the existing type_i_a_gt_one_overflow_residual predicate
target_shapes.admission_requirement: target must be rebuilt by the common serializer and accepted by the common admission gate

target_shapes.t5_ticket_type: must provide one fixed-N7 ticket before admission
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: reject by default; coordinator must assign a unique owner after predicate and overlap review
target_shapes.admission_requirement: remain NEW_FAMILY_CANDIDATE and nonrecursive until F1 grammar, T2/T3 obligations, serializer, lift, and re-entry are approved

e1_e5_contract.E1: Actual source envelope plus a path-bound integer q_perp occurrence with side/node/exponent/capacity and one-use charge conservation; ideal divisibility and q_perp|k are insufficient.
e1_e5_contract.E2: One deterministic integer target from q_perp and the verified source payload, with all tie-breaks fixed.
e1_e5_contract.E3: Target passes the coordinator-owned common serializer, family predicates, unique owner selection, digest verification, and admission gate.
e1_e5_contract.E4: A total solution lift over the entire selected branch, not a fixture or witness-only map.
e1_e5_contract.E5: The actual parent and final admitted target strictly decrease the fixed T5 N7 potential.
e1_e5_contract.reentry: Every nonterminal target is admitted into the frozen F1 grammar, otherwise the result remains a rejected candidate.

requested_coordinator_decisions: approve the QC1PhysicalTransitionV1 envelope name and version
do not approve an ideal-norm charge rule until an integer occurrence and conservation theorem is supplied

defer producer registration until the integer occurrence/conservation theorem exists; the eventual rule would use R3/R5 branch ids, proper_root_stutter_k_gt_one source owner, and type_i_a_gt_one_overflow_residual target owner
freeze the common terminal dispatcher consumed before target admission
provide the common admission API binding used for E3 and re-entry
confirm that no new family, mark, atomic arm, or T2/T3 extension is required
